sources.name: 2027 Tech Jobs — off-cycle and new-grad tracker
sources.why: Graduation-cycle tracker with separate off-cycle internship and new-grad lists; useful for December graduation rather than only summer internships.
sources.limits: Community labels are not employer-confirmed eligibility. Summer 2027 roles often require continued enrollment. Filter US, 0–3 years, cloud/platform/backend/data.

sources.query: new grad infrastructure cloud platform backend data 2026 2027

sources.name: ApplyGuy employer-linked 2027 new-grad feed
sources.why: Machine-readable early-career feed links to employer listings; adds fresher direct career pages to a small dashboard.
sources.limits: Entries may include clearance roles. Use listingUrl rather than paid application links. Source's inferred entry-level label must be checked against full description.
sources.access: Public JSON object with jobs[], updatedAt, title, company, location, posted, listingUrl
sources.free: Free listing feed; optional application service separate
sources.query: cloud platform infrastructure backend software engineer I

sources.name: Hacker News — Who is hiring
sources.why: Hiring-company posts disclose stack and direct recruiting contacts; useful for infrastructure startups and referral outreach.
sources.limits: Free-form posts need employer-description checks; sponsorship is often unspecified. October 2026 thread observed. No automatic assumption that remote means US eligible.
sources.access: Public official Firebase API; monthly parent item and child comments
sources.query: junior new grad Azure Terraform platform infrastructure Python React sponsor

sources.name: Y Combinator startup engineering jobs
sources.why: Startup-specific employer cards expose experience and will-sponsor labels, with cloud infrastructure and DevOps roles and direct founder access.
sources.limits: Public summaries sometimes contradict descriptions. BotBuilt new-grad badge conflicts with 3–5-year requirement and dead employer link. Require current full JD and confirm first-time sponsorship.
sources.access: Public discovery; free account may be needed to apply; import direct employer ATS listing
sources.query: DevOps infrastructure software engineer new grads will sponsor

sources.name: DevOpsHunt — DevOps/SRE/platform
sources.why: Specific to cloud infrastructure and platform engineering; role and sponsorship filters reduce noise.
sources.limits: Some employer names masked. Optional applications cost credits. Aggregated sponsor tags are signals. Observed intern listing needs December-graduation check.
sources.access: Public browsing and free account; no public feed verified; paste employer JD
sources.free: Public preview/free account; paid managed applications excluded
sources.query: Azure Terraform junior early careers infrastructure intern

sources.name: Kube Careers — curated Kubernetes roles
sources.why: Narrow infrastructure board with compensation and direct employer links; useful platform/SRE watchlist if Kubernetes skills are supported.
sources.limits: Website fetch timed out during verification. Official curated Telegram feed accessible. Many senior roles; sponsorship and Kubernetes experience need verification.
sources.access: Public website and official Telegram previews; no machine-readable API verified
sources.query: United States junior platform engineer cloud Azure
